_comment: Endpoints the api-test-generator must NEVER execute, because hitting them breaks the authenticated session the rest of the run depends on. Entries are merged ON TOP of the built-in defaults (password reset/forgot/change, logout/revoke, DELETE /me). Each entry is a path regex string (any method) or {"method": <VERB>, "path": <regex>}. Matching is case-insensitive. Edit per target.
